title: UI-Designer Schwerpunkt E-Commerce (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Webmatch GmbH
description_html:
Einleitung

Willkommen bei Webmatch. Wir entwickeln skalierbare E-Commerce-Plattformen (Onlineshops und transaktionale Websites) für Hersteller, Händler und Marken.
Als User Interface Designer:in sorgst du für den richtigen Look & Feel in unseren Projekten und gestaltest moderne und ansprechende Interfaces.
Klingt nach einem Match? Dann bewirb dich in Voll- oder Teilzeit und begeistere uns mit deinem ganz persönlichen Designstil.

Aufgaben

Der Fokus deiner Rolle liegt auf der visuellen Ausgestaltung von Benutzeroberflächen. Dabei setzt du stilsicher Farben, Typografie und Gestaltungselemente ein und entwickelst moderne und hochwertige Designkonzepte. Mit systemischen Einschränkungen kannst du umgehen und hast den Anspruch das Maximum herauszuholen, was technisch realisierbar ist. Wenn es mal eng wird unterstützt du das UX-Team bei der Gestaltung von Wireframes.
Deine Rolle im Detail:

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Designsprache in deinen Projekten und entwickelst diese von der ersten Idee bis zum Live-Gang
  • Du entwickelst Moodboards, visuelle Leitideen, Screendesigns und arbeitest diese final aus
  • Du gestaltest und pflegst Design-Systeme und Pattern Libraries
  • Bonus: Du hast Erfahrung mit Shopware oder einem anderen E-Commerce-System
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Konzept, Entwicklung und Projektmanagement zusammen

Qualifikation

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von digitalen Produkten, vorzugsweise im E-Commerce Umfeld
  • Technische Restriktionen sind für dich kein Hindernis, sondern der Rahmen. Darin gestaltest du Oberflächen, die auffallen und umsetzbar bleiben
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma und der Adobe Creative Suite
  • Solide UX-Kenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab
  • Exzellentes Gespür für Farben, Formen, Schriften und Proportionen
  • Leidenschaft für aktuellen Design und UX-Trends
  • Du bist wissbegierig und probierst gerne neue Dinge aus
  • Selbstständige und methodische Arbeitsweise, mit einem gesunden Pragmatismus

Benefits

Bei uns genießt du alle Vorzüge, die das Arbeiten in einer Mid-Size Agentur mit sich bringt: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Eigenverantwortung und schlanke Strukturen.
So vielfältig wie unsere Projekte sind auch unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jeder findet hier den Rahmen für ein erfolgreiches und erfülltes Arbeiten. Remote oder im Büro, Teil- oder Vollzeit, mit oder ohne Personalverantwortung.
Gemeinsam finden wir auch das richtige Setting für dich.
Weiterhin erwartet dich:

  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Fördermöglichkeiten
  • Benefits wie Deutschlandticket, Jobrad, Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, Mitarbeiterrabatte und zusätzliche Urlaubstage
  • An zwei Arbeitstagen pro Monat treffen wir uns alle in unseren Agenturräumen in der Kölner City. Dann frühstücken wir zusammen oder batteln uns auch mal bei Mario Kart. An den restlichen Tagen entscheidest du selber, ob du aus dem Home-Office oder aus unserem klimatisierten Büro arbeiten möchtest.
  • Freut auch Bello: Bring deinen Hund einfach mit in die Agentur
  • Hochwertiges Equipment (MacBook Pro) und Tool-Landschaft
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

Warum wir?

Auch wenn nicht alle Punkte auf dich zutreffen, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Vielleicht stehst du als UI-Designer:in gerade vor der Herausforderung dich stärker in UX-Themen einzuarbeiten zu wollen. Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeiten und Unterstützung, die es dafür braucht.

Sende uns einfach deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Portfolio zu. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch.
Bitte füge in dein Anschreiben oder CV den Satz „Ich brenne für UI/UX“ ein, um zu zeigen, dass du unsere Stellenanzeige aufmerksam gelesen hast. Ohne diese Angabe können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen, da uns eine Vielzahl an Bewerbungen erreicht. Dieser Schritt dient gleichzeitig als erste Vorauswahl.

title: Junior Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Erasys
description_html:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

title: Inhouse Customer Service Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vestiairecollective
description_html:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion.
 
Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.
 
Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US.
Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.
 
Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

About the role

As Head of Level 3 Customer Service, you will lead Vestiaire Collective’s expert and escalation teams in Paris and New York.

Your teams will resolve our most complex and sensitive customer cases, ensuring fair, efficient and consistent outcomes. You will also use customer insights to address root causes and prevent recurring issues.

Reporting to the VP Customer Service, you will strengthen our Level 3 operating model, improve performance and develop a high-performing international team. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong people management, sound judgement, customer empathy and effective cross-functional collaboration.


Key responsibilities

1. Lead Level 3 operations and escalations

  • Lead Level 3 operations across Paris and New York remotely, ensuring complex and sensitive cases are resolved effectively.

  • Personally handle critical or high-impact cases and speak directly with customers when appropriate.

  • Own the escalation framework and oversee high-risk, reputational or executive cases.

  • Ensure fair and consistent decisions aligned with company policies.

  • Identify root causes and recurring issues to prevent future escalations.

  • Monitor performance, including resolution time, backlog, quality and customer satisfaction.

    •  

    2. Improve processes and customer experience

  • Continuously improve the Level 3 operating model, processes and playbook.

  • Empower experts through clear decision-making principles and guidelines.

  • Turn customer insights into actionable improvements.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with Legal, Policy, Trust & Safety, Product, Operations and other teams.

  • Improve collaboration and escalation flows across Levels 1, 2 and 3.

    •  

    3. Lead and develop the team

  • Build and maintain a high-performing international team of 8 members through effective workforce planning, recruitment, coaching and performance management.

  • Set clear objectives and maintain strong performance and quality standards.

  • Build team capabilities in investigation, decision-making and de-escalation.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus.

  • Create opportunities for team members to develop and grow.


    • What success looks like

    Within 6 to 12 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear and scalable Level 3 model.

  • Improved the speed, quality and consistency of case resolution.

  • Reduced recurring issues and avoidable escalations.

  • Strengthened cross-functional collaboration and performance reporting.

  • Developed an engaged, empowered and high-performing expert team.


    • About you

    Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Service, Customer Operations or a related environment, including at least 3 years of experience managing teams.

  • Proven experience leading escalations, complaints, expert support or Level 3 customer service function.

  • Experience managing teams in an international, multilingual and multichannel environment.

  • Strong experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Legal, Policy, Trust & Safety, Public Relations, Product or Operations.

  • Demonstrated experience leading process improvement or operational transformation projects.

  • Experience using data and performance indicators to identify issues, prioritise actions and measure impact.

  • Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or fast-growing technology company is a strong plus.

    • Skills and behaviours

  • Strong people leadership, coaching and performance management skills.

  • Excellent judgement, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives and risk.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.

  • Structured, detail-oriented and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluent in French and excellent command of English. Additional languages are a plus.

    • What We Offer

    • Purpose-driven work at scale
      Join a company reshaping the fashion industry towards circularity, you directly contributes to reducing waste and extending the life of luxury items.
    • High-impact scope & ownership
      Work on products used globally, where your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on millions of users across 70+ countries.
    • A truly international environment
      Collaborate with a diverse team of 50+ nationalities across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City.
    • Career acceleration in a fast-moving scale-up
      Take ownership early, grow fast, and shape your path, as an expert or a future leader.
    • Learning & growth as a priority
      Dedicated budget, continuous feedback culture, and opportunities to work on cutting-edge topics (AI, marketplace dynamics, scalability, etc.).
    • Flexible ways of working
      Hybrid model (typically 2 days remote per week), with trust and autonomy at the core of how we operate.
    • Give back through action
      2 paid days per year to support a cause of your choice and actively contribute to positive impact beyond your day-to-day role.
    • Competitive compensation & benefits
      Including bonus, health coverage, lunch vouchers, Gym-Pass, and additional legal perks depending on your location.

     

     

    Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities, are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria.

    At Vestiaire Collective, we believe diversity drives better decisions, stronger products, and more meaningful impact.
    If this role excites you but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply, your perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

    Vestiaire Collective is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

     

    PS: We take candidate experience seriously, and your safety too !

    Vestiaire Collective will only contact you through official email addresses ending in We will never:

    • Contact you via WhatsApp, Telegram, or similar platforms
    • Ask for payment or banking information at any stage of the process

title: Retail Area Manager
description_html:
What you'll do:
  • Support new store launches in France, helping coordinate with franchise and store partners to ensure smooth openings, proper training, and operational readiness.
  • Track store performance and support revenue growth by monitoring trends, helping optimize costs, and flagging risks early.
  • Monitor OTIF (On-Time, In-Full) deliveries, support inventory tracking, and help resolve day-to-day operational issues with logistics teams.
  • Help apply and roll out playbooks and best practices across stores, contributing ideas to improve conversion rates and customer experience.

As our Head of Treasury, you will own Qonto's day-to-day treasury operations during a pivotal moment: our transition from a payment institution to a fully licensed bank. You will manage daily cash flows, lead a team of three, and ensure we are operationally ready to meet banking regulatory requirements from day one.

You will report directly to Frédéric Giraud, our Director of Core Finance.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Manage and optimize daily cash flows, ensuring proper placement and liquidity management under banking regulatory constraints
  • Lead your treasury team through the transition: two Treasury Managers and our Treasury & Systems Expert, who handles our banking infrastructure (SEPA, SWIFT, TMS)
  • Serve as the primary treasury contact for our banking license project - conducting the gap analysis between our current PSP operations and banking requirements, and building the roadmap to get us there
  • Execute ALM strategies defined by our ALM team and validated by the ALM Committee, translating directives into operational reality
  • Be the credible interface between treasury operations and our Product & Tech teams (Arnaud Alépée's core banking team) to ensure our systems are aligned with banking requirements
  • Work directly with our Risk & Compliance teams on regulatory implementation

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Operational cash management: You have hands-on experience managing significant cash volumes in a bank or large corporate environment (CAC 40 / midcap). You've managed daily positions, intraday liquidity, and cash flows - not just forecasts or reports.
  • Banking environment: You come from a licensed bank or a large organization with real banking treasury constraints. You understand the difference between PSP and bank treasury operations - concretely, not theoretically.
  • Systems fluency: You're comfortable with payment infrastructure (SEPA, SWIFT) and treasury management tools (Kyriba, Murex, SAP). You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to speak the language.
  • Team leadership: You've managed a team of at least 2-3 people in treasury or finance, with different profiles and skill sets.
  • Ownership mindset: You question processes, identify inefficiencies, and take initiative without waiting to be told. You adapt quickly to new environments and build where nothing exists yet.
  • ALM execution: You've worked alongside an ALM team and know how to translate their directives into operational actions - without pretending to be the strategist.
  • French: Fluent French is required for ACPR interactions and the French banking environment.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real operational ownership: You'll manage significant cash volumes in a regulated banking environment - this is a hands-on role, not a strategic advisory one. You'll be in the details.
  • A transformation you'll shape: Qonto is building its banking treasury infrastructure from scratch. You won't be inheriting a polished machine - you'll be building it, and that requires someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for processes to be defined.
  • A technical dimension: You'll pilot Alioune, our systems expert, and act as the bridge between treasury operations and our engineering and product teams. Understanding payment rails (SEPA, SWIFT) and treasury tools (Kyriba, Murex, SAP) is part of the job.
  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll work closely with ALM, Risk & Compliance, and Qonto's core banking team - at the intersection of operations, regulation, and product.

➡️ Your future manager

Frédéric brings deep banking expertise from his years at Société Générale, complemented by nine years at Younited - making him uniquely positioned to guide you through this PSP-to-bank transformation. He'll provide strategic direction while giving you full ownership of treasury execution and team management.

description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


➡️ Mission: Join us to build the data solutions that serve more than 600,000 customers. As a Data Engineer, you make data safe, fresh, and self-service for the almost 2,000 Qontoers who rely on it every day.

➡️ The team: You will join the Data Platform team: Data Platform Engineers, Data Engineers and Data SREs. We own our stack end to end — Trino, Metabase, Airflow, OpenMetadata and more are deployed, run and maintained in-house by the team.

➡️ As a Data Solution Engineer at Qonto, you will:

Deliver end-to-end data solutions: You will own data solutions from the need to production — ingestion into Snowflake, exposure through Trino and Metabase, and the automation around them — for business-critical use cases.

Make self-service real: You will turn recurring manual requests into reusable, documented, low-maintenance building blocks, so teams stop asking and start serving themselves.

Be the trusted interface for data consumers: You will run our duty and Office Hours, qualify incoming requests, and decide what deserves a quick fix, a proper solution, or a platform change.

Own data quality and freshness: You will define contracts, tests and SLAs on the data you ship, and investigate pipeline incidents through to root cause rather than symptom.

Run our open-source stack: You will manage the open-source tools the Data Platform team owns, deploys and maintains — Trino, Metabase, Airflow, OpenMetadata and more — and keep them stable for production use cases.

➡️ What you can expect:

A central role: You will sit at the intersection of the platform and the whole company, in a mature environment where your work directly changes how Qonto decides and operates.

Modern tech stack: A state-of-the-art cloud-native stack — Python, SQL, Snowflake, Airflow, Trino, Metabase, OpenMetadata, Kubernetes, AWS.

High autonomy: You will join a team of senior engineers where ownership is key; you will be trusted with important topics from day one.

Hyper-growth context: You will work on the challenges of scaling data for a leading European fintech, on a platform serving thousands of users daily.

➡️ About your future manager: You will report to Charles, who leads the Data Platform team. He has been building Qonto's data stack for years and knows it end-to-end, so the technical guidance you get is first-hand. As a manager, he values autonomy and acts as a facilitator: he gives the team the space to own its topics and step up, and he is there when a decision needs a second pair of eyes.

➡️ About You:

- Experience: You have 3+ years of experience in Data or Software Engineering, having shipped and operated data pipelines and data services in production.
- Technical mastery: You are strong in Python, and you understand data-specific infrastructure and solutions — how a warehouse, a query engine and an orchestrator actually behave, and which one is the right answer to a given need.
- Tooling expertise: You have run open-source data tools yourself — orchestration, query engines, BI — with Airflow and Snowflake preferred, and you are not afraid to debug the infrastructure under them, where experience with Kubernetes and AWS makes the difference. You are comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD.
- End-to-end ownership: You take a project from a rough need to a shipped solution: you do the product management yourself — challenge the request, scope it with the stakeholder, define what gets built — and then you build it yourself.
- AI fluency: You use AI tools daily in your engineering work (coding agents, LLM-based automation) and you have a clear view of where they help and where they do not.
- Appetite to learn: You are keen to learn a lot, fast, across a broad stack — you see an unfamiliar tool as a reason to dig in rather than a blocker.
- Communication: You have strong communication skills and can translate between business needs and technical constraints, in both directions.
- Languages: You speak fluent English.

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

  • Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

    • Partner Relationship Management:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

  • Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

  • Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

    • Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

    • Program Development & Optimization:

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management


    • Qualifications:
  • Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent. 

  • You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment. 

  • You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology

  • Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, KPI driven approach.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.

    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

title: Responsable Contrôle Qualité (FinTech) - F/H

description_html:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Plus de 1,5 million de clients utilisent déjà Younited à travers l’Europe.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Younited en quelques chiffres

    • 4 pays européens, avec près de 50 % de notre activité réalisée en dehors de la France.
    • Environ 500 Younies répartis entre Paris, Rome, Barcelone et Lisbonne.
    • La confiance de grandes entreprises, parmi lesquelles Iliad, Bouygues Telecom, Free, Bpifrance, Apple, N26, Fortuneo, Smeg et Thermomix.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.

title: Retail Trainer – EMEA South (h/f/d)
description_html:
Votre opportunité chez ARC’TERYX

Le/La Retail Trainer conçoit et déploie des initiatives de formation à travers la région. À ce titre, il/elle collabore avec les principales parties prenantes afin d’identifier les besoins en formation, les tendances et les opportunités au sein de la région, puis crée, adapte et met en œuvre des programmes de formation en partenariat avec les équipes Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising et autres départements concernés.

Vous contribuerez également à l’excellence de la formation au niveau régional grâce à une combinaison de stratégie d’apprentissage, de coaching terrain et d’accompagnement des ouvertures de nouveaux magasins. Vous serez responsable de la conduite des formations liées aux New Store Openings (NSO), y compris pendant la semaine d’intégration « Basecamp ». Cela comprend la planification et l’animation des programmes de formation pour les ouvertures de magasins dans toute la région, ainsi que la garantie de la qualité et du taux de réalisation des formations NSO.

Dans ce poste, vous gérerez le calendrier régional de formation et serez responsable de l’efficacité des formations sur votre marché. Une connaissance approfondie des opérations retail et des initiatives de formation d’Arc’teryx est essentielle à la réussite de ce rôle.

Vous reporterez au/à la Manager, Retail Training EMEA. Vous devrez faire preuve d’une grande réactivité face à l’évolution des priorités et des échéances. D’excellentes compétences en communication, leadership et collaboration sont indispensables pour réussir dans cette fonction.

Ce poste est basé à Paris. Les candidats doivent maîtriser la langue locale afin de soutenir les équipes de leur marché et devront travailler depuis les magasins de leur région au minimum 3 jours par semaine.

Les indicateurs de réussite dans ce rôle

  • Déployer une stratégie de formation régionale alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux et la performance des magasins.
  • Garantir que les nouveaux magasins atteignent les jalons de préparation à la formation avant leur ouverture.
  • Assurer un fort taux de participation et d’adoption des principaux programmes et initiatives d’apprentissage.
  • Développer des partenariats solides avec les Regional Managers et les équipes de direction des magasins.
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration de l’efficacité des formations grâce aux retours d’expérience et à l’analyse des performances.
  • Promouvoir une culture d’apprentissage, de coaching et de développement au sein d’EMEA South.

Votre future équipe

Votre rôle au sein de l’équipe Retail Training est essentiel à la croissance de l’entreprise et à l’atteinte de ses objectifs. Intégrée à l’équipe Store Development & Operations, l’équipe Retail Training soutient le développement de notre réseau de magasins et la réalisation de nos ambitions commerciales.

Notre mission consiste à créer des programmes d’apprentissage de référence, accompagner les ouvertures de magasins, former les équipes lors du déploiement d’initiatives et fournir les connaissances nécessaires pour permettre à notre activité de se développer efficacement et durablement.

Vous contribuerez au développement de nos collaborateurs afin qu’ils réalisent pleinement leur potentiel et participent à une culture de haute performance.


En tant que Retail Trainer – EMEA South, vos missions seront les suivantes :

Excellence de la formation régionale

  • Collaborer avec les équipes du siège sur des initiatives de formation à grande échelle.
  • Développer des stratégies de formation favorisant l’engagement, la rétention des connaissances et l’adoption des programmes.
  • Participer à la création et/ou piloter la conception et le déploiement des contenus de formation.
  • Utiliser les supports de formation existants, les adapter et les traduire dans la langue locale en tenant compte des spécificités culturelles.
  • Animer des formations et des sessions « train-the-trainer » sur les initiatives, programmes, produits et autres besoins de formation.
  • Maintenir une connaissance approfondie des opérations magasin Arc’teryx, des meilleures pratiques de leadership et de l’offre produit.
  • Évaluer et communiquer les points forts ainsi que les opportunités d’amélioration de la formation dans votre région.
  • Développer et maintenir une expertise approfondie des produits Arc’teryx.

    • Ouvertures de nouveaux magasins (NSO)

    • Déployer les formations liées aux ouvertures de nouveaux magasins, fournir un soutien opérationnel et merchandising, et participer aux inaugurations pour garantir leur succès.
    • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Retail Operations et les chefs de projet NSO afin d’intégrer efficacement la formation au processus global d’ouverture.
    • Assurer la coordination et la mise en œuvre de l’ensemble des formations du programme NSO.
    • Observer les équipes en magasin, les accompagner par le coaching et fournir des retours constructifs tout au long du processus d’ouverture.
    • Animer les réunions et appels de formation dédiés aux ouvertures dont vous avez la responsabilité.
    • Remonter les points d’attention, obtenir les alignements nécessaires et conseiller les parties prenantes sur les décisions clés, les dépenses et les actions liées au programme de formation NSO.
    • Conseiller sur les éventuels budgets à prévoir pour chaque ouverture dans votre région.
    • Les déplacements représentent environ 50 à 70 % du temps de travail et incluent des visites régulières en magasin, l’animation de formations régionales ainsi que l’accompagnement continu des ouvertures de magasins.

      • Développement des magasins et coaching

    • Collaborer avec les Regional Managers et les équipes de management magasin (Store Managers, Assistant Store Managers, Leads) afin de garantir le développement des compétences et la qualité des parcours de formation.
    • Maintenir une bonne connaissance des descriptifs et responsabilités de l’ensemble des fonctions retail.
    • Auditer les pratiques de formation et de développement en magasin et promouvoir une mise en œuvre cohérente et qualitative des programmes.
    • Travailler avec les Regional Managers pour évaluer les besoins de formation régionaux et soutenir les ouvertures de nouveaux magasins.
    • Collaborer avec les équipes transverses afin de concevoir et déployer des formations produits et expérience client pour les activités retail et wholesale.
    • Communiquer avec les partenaires internes (Operations, Visual Merchandising, Brand, etc.) concernant les besoins spécifiques en matière de formation.
    • Développer des relations solides avec les équipes de magasin.

Voici quelques-uns des sujets sur lesquels vous pourriez travailler à l'avenir :
  • Collaborer avec des partenaires régionaux et internationaux pour façonner l’avenir de l’apprentissage retail au sein d’EMEA South.
  • Travailler avec le/la Manager, Retail Training et les équipes transverses pour faire évoluer l’expérience d’intégration et les parcours de formation liés aux ouvertures de magasins.
  • Concevoir des semaines complètes de formation pour les équipes en intégrant les priorités définies par les responsables de magasin.
  • Adapter et déployer les initiatives de formation mondiales au niveau régional.
  • Exploiter les données de performance et les retours des apprenants afin d’améliorer continuellement l’efficacité des formations et leur impact sur les résultats de l’entreprise.

    • Êtes-vous notre prochain(e) Retail Trainer – EMEA South ?
  • Diplôme de niveau Licence/Bachelor en Éducation, Formation, Commerce, Gestion de projet ou domaine similaire, avec plus de 3 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions de management retail, de formation ou d’excellence opérationnelle/support retail.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la conception, l’animation et le déploiement de programmes de formation à fort impact atteignant ou dépassant les objectifs de performance.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, animation et développement de relations, avec la capacité d’influencer et de collaborer à tous les niveaux de l’organisation ; maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais (l’italien est un atout).
  • Maîtrise avancée des outils Microsoft Office, notamment Excel et SharePoint.
  • Expérience dans l’accompagnement des ouvertures de magasins au sein d’un environnement retail intégré, avec une forte disponibilité pour les déplacements.
  • Esprit proactif, orienté solutions et sens des responsabilités, avec une grande capacité d’adaptation dans des environnements évolutifs et ambigus.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en favorisant la collaboration, l’amélioration continue et l’innovation.
  • Passion pour le retail, le développement des talents et les activités de plein air.

    • Temps de travail : Temps plein | 5 jours par semaine

    Rémunération : Salaire fixe + bonus

     Évoluer chez Arc’teryx

    La progression chez Arc’teryx repose sur la pratique, le feedback et le soutien d’une communauté solidaire. Alors que nous continuons à ouvrir de nouveaux magasins dans la région, de nouvelles opportunités se créent pour les collaborateurs souhaitant développer leurs compétences et assumer davantage de responsabilités.

     Ce que nous valorisons dans nos équipes

    Nos magasins réunissent des collaborateurs issus de cultures, de langues et d’horizons variés. Cette diversité façonne notre manière d’apprendre les uns des autres et d’accompagner nos clients.

     Notre processus de recrutement

    Notre processus de recrutement est simple, transparent et réfléchi. Nous étudions chaque candidature avec attention et vous contacterons si votre expérience correspond à ce que nous recherchons.

    Avantages & bénéfices

    • VIVEZ-LE (LIVE IT) : Du temps et la liberté nécessaires pour vous reconnecter à la nature et mener une vie porteuse de sens.
    • Organisation des plannings : Des horaires prévisibles et une planification favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
    • Arc’ Adventure : Un programme de reconnaissance des collaborateurs offrant des expériences outdoor.
    • Développement & apprentissage : Accès à des formations en leadership, ateliers de développement des compétences et programmes d’évolution de carrière.
    • Bien-être : Des ressources et programmes favorisant le bien-être physique, mental et financier.
    • Accès aux produits : Un généreux programme d’achats collaborateurs ainsi que des offres professionnelles du secteur.
    • Care & Repair : Accès à des conseils d’entretien et à des services de réparation produits en accord avec notre engagement ReBIRD.

    *Les avantages peuvent varier selon le poste et le lieu de travail.


    Equal Opportunity
     
    Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 
     
    Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  
     
    All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

title: Engagement Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Intelance
description_html:
Intelance helps organisations make practical decisions about technology, costs and change. We are looking for a freelance Engagement Manager to run the delivery of technology assessments alongside our engagement partner and architects.

You will manage the work plan, client requests, budget tracking and review process. Assignments may involve around 18 days across an eight week assessment. Scope and days are agreed for each assignment. Primarily remote within the UK, with occasional client meetings agreed in advance.

Tasks

  • Build and maintain the delivery plan, responsibilities and review schedule.
  • Coordinate client interviews and evidence requests without repeating work.
  • Track delivery effort, dependencies, risks and agreed actions.
  • Prepare concise weekly progress updates and escalate decisions early.
  • Check that reports and review packs are complete and consistent.
  • Coordinate client comments, agreed presentations and final handover.

Requirements

  • Experience managing consulting engagements or technology assessments with external clients.
  • Able to coordinate architects and specialists while keeping scope and effort under control.
  • Confident handling senior client conversations and sensitive findings.
  • Strong written English and practical use of Microsoft 365.
  • Experience managing document reviews, commercial boundaries and delivery risks.
  • Financial services or professional services experience is useful.

Benefits

  • £450 to £525 per day, depending on relevant experience. Rates exclude VAT where applicable. Contracting route and tax status will be confirmed before an assignment is agreed.
  • Direct partnership with the engagement lead and a specialist delivery team.
  • Defined outputs and flexible working days.
  • Primarily remote working, with necessary travel agreed in advance.
  • Potential for further assignments by mutual agreement. No minimum volume of work is guaranteed.

Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. No cover letter is needed. Shortlisted candidates will discuss relevant assignments, availability and rate with us. We will agree scope, working days and contract terms before work starts. Please do not include confidential client documents.

We are looking for a freelance Principal Enterprise Architect to lead detailed architecture work within financial services assessments. description_html:
Intelance helps organisations make practical decisions about technology, costs and change. We are looking for a freelance Technology Cost Analyst to build clear, evidence based views of technology spending for client assessments.

description_html:
Intelance works with UK organisations that need clear, practical decisions about technology. We are building a trusted group of senior associates to lead short enterprise architecture engagements. This project based contract role is for someone who can understand how decisions are made, find where ownership or information is unclear, and give senior leaders a plan they can use.

Tasks

You will:

  • Lead current state enterprise architecture reviews from the first interview to the executive readout.
  • Interview senior business and technology leaders, then explain the findings in plain English.
  • Map how decisions are made across applications, data, integration, security, operations and change.
  • Test early findings against real decisions, documents and other evidence.
  • Identify unclear ownership, duplicated effort, avoidable risk and important dependencies.
  • Design practical options, clear decision rights and a costed roadmap.
  • Produce board ready reports, diagrams and presentations.
  • Work with Intelance associates while owning the quality of the work and the client relationship.

Requirements

You must have:

  • At least 10 years of enterprise architecture, business architecture or technology governance experience.
  • Personally led a current state assessment from discovery through to an executive readout.
  • Experience interviewing and presenting to Board, COO, CIO or equivalent leaders.
  • Strong knowledge of applications, data, integration, security, operating models and technology governance.
  • Recent work in a law firm, professional services partnership, financial services firm or another regulated organisation.
  • Evidence that you can turn complex findings into clear written advice and practical decisions.
  • The confidence to challenge senior people calmly and work without depending on a large consulting team.

description_html:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Social Media Director - 4 month FTC - part-time

This is a senior leadership opportunity to shape and lead social media strategy and execution for a global domestic appliances brand, spanning categories including air fryers, vacuum cleaners, and coffee machines. 

Based within a newly established global in‑house studio in Amsterdam, this role sits at the heart of the brand's digital transformation. The studio operates with the speed and creative ambition of an agency, combined with the strategic depth and scale of an in‑house team, delivering social‑first strategy, content, and influencer activity across global and local markets. 

As Social Media Director, you will define how the brand shows up across platforms, creators, and communities worldwide - setting the vision, building high‑performing teams, and ensuring social delivers meaningful brand and business impact. You will be a key driver of social‑first thinking, innovation, and the integration of Generative AI across strategy, content, and operations. 

ABOUT YOU 

We're looking for a highly accomplished, digitally fluent social media and influencer leader with 10+ years' experience, ideally gained within agency or hybrid in‑house environments. 

You are a strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset, proven experience managing complex global stakeholders, and a passion for the power of social media and influencer marketing to drive growth. You bring a deep understanding of platform dynamics, evolving social behaviours, creator ecosystems, and emerging technologies (particularly Generative AI) and know how to translate these insights into scalable, impactful solutions. 

You are an inspiring, collaborative leader, comfortable managing and mentoring large, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and building modern ways of working. You are data‑driven, creatively ambitious, and deeply attuned to what makes brands and consumers connect in today's fast‑moving digital landscape. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Leadership & Team Management 

  • Lead, coach, and inspire social and influencer teams to deliver best‑in‑class, social‑first work 
  • Provide line management to senior social and influencer leads, partnering closely with Creative, Strategy, Production, and Performance leadership 
  • Build a strong, future‑ready social capability within the studio, fostering collaboration, innovation, and excellence 
  • Act as the senior social point of contact for client stakeholders, guiding vision and decision‑making 
  • Drive year‑on‑year growth against agreed KPIs, managing complex stakeholder relationships effectively 

Strategy & Client Partnership 

  • Own the global social vision for the brand, enabling local relevance at scale 
  • Oversee the development of comprehensive social and influencer strategies, informed by insight, performance data, and AI‑powered analytics 
  • Provide senior‑level social consultancy to client leadership, producing clear strategy frameworks and playbooks 
  • Build trusted, long‑term client relationships and proactively respond to evolving business needs 
  • Contribute to the development of innovative proposals and new opportunities within the account 

Operational Excellence & Innovation 

  • Establish and embed best practices, processes, and ways of working that drive operational efficiency and creative quality 
  • Ensure teams maintain deep platform expertise and social‑first thinking across all work 
  • Direct social and influencer output across global and regional markets 
  • Champion measurement, effectiveness, and performance‑led optimisation 
  • Educate stakeholders on the role of social in building brands and driving measurable outcomes 

Innovation & Technology 

  • Lead the integration of Generative AI into social and influencer strategy, content creation, and operations 
  • Stay at the forefront of social platform innovation, creator trends, and emerging technologies 
  • Drive experimentation and innovation at the intersection of human creativity and AI 
  • Scale GenAI tools and proprietary technology responsibly across the studio 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS 

  • Strategic Vision & Commercial Acumen: 
    10+ years' experience in social media marketing with a strong track record of delivering effective, commercially successful strategies 
  • Leadership & Operational Excellence: 
    Proven experience leading and developing teams within fast‑paced, high‑performance environments 
  • Client Relationship Management: 
    Exceptional ability to influence, negotiate, and manage senior stakeholders across global or large regional organisations 
  • Influencer Marketing Expertise: 
    Understanding of the influencer landscape, including talent selection, relationship management, contracting, content production, data analysis, and strategy 
  • Innovation & AI Understanding: 
    Strong grasp of social platform evolution, emerging trends, and a genuine interest in AI and generative technologies 
  • Creative Excellence: 
    Highly creative, with a sharp instinct for social‑native storytelling and effective brand collaborations 
  • Paid Social Knowledge: 
    Solid understanding of the role of paid media in amplifying social and influencer activity 
  • Communication Skills: 
    Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; fluent in English (additional EU languages a plus) 
  • Data‑Driven Approach: 
    Experience using performance data and insights to inform strategy, optimisation, and decision‑making

description_html:
The Role 

Planning and scheduling tasks across our complex nanosatellite constellation and ground station network is critical to Spire's business success. These tasks include radio communication between space and ground as well as orbital maneuvers to hold positional goals, including converging on and holding multi-satellite formations. 

 

We are seeking a skilled Mathematical Software Engineer to help enhance our ground-based systems responsible for that critical scheduling capability. As that engineer, you will contribute to the development of our intelligent automated systems for planning the operations over the upcoming hours and days. You will design, build and deploy new features of our scheduling systems to make them more capable and resilient. 

 

What you'll do as a Mathematical Software Engineer: 

  • Develop new scheduling capabilities such new types of orbital maneuver planning, or ground-system contact scheduling strategies.
  • Iterate on features based on stakeholder feedback and evolving requirements from the business.

title: Staff / Principal Design Engineer, Web
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Lovable
description_html:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer who combines strong frontend engineering fundamentals with a sharp eye for craft to execute on our website. You’ll work closely with design and marketing to build world-class web content helping empower the next generation of creators and builders.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of years experience, shipping websites and landing pages users genuinely love

  • Portfolio demonstrating landing pages and advanced web interactions (if you don’t have a portfolio of landing pages - check out our other roles)

  • Ability to make smart trade-offs between speed and polish, knowing when to ship and when to refine

  • Strong fundamental understanding of modern frontend systems - React architecture, state management, performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns

  • Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready experiences

  • Strong design sense with an eye for detail, accessibility, and usability

  • Ideally - you push the boundaries of the web with technologies like WebGL

What you’ll do

In one sentence: Own and elevate landing pages and web experiences that help share Lovable with the world.

  • Build landing pages that delight, also designing interactions or pairing closely with designers

  • Implement web interactions in React/TypeScript with obsessive attention to performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser consistency

  • Drive front-end execution - pioneering new interaction patterns, micro-animations, and delightful details that elevate the entire experience

  • Collaborate with marketing, helping share Lovable with the world

  • Explore and iterate on visual designs with designers, translating explorations into scalable, web-native implementations

  • Build and maintain reusable components that enhance consistency while enabling creativity across both product and marketing

  • Reinvent how teams build for the web

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next!

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.

  2. Show us some of your work you’re really proud of.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews, including a technical screening where we evaluate frontend engineering fundamentals at the same level we expect from Product Engineers.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

  • For this role, we're prioritising candidates based in New York

Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our Business Analytics team is growing! We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our team in London.

In this role you will help turn our Rewards and Core data into clear, trusted answers, building reporting and analysis that the business actually makes decisions on, and learning to do it AI-natively from day one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vertical commercial reporting end to end, measuring monthly gross profit, reconciling it to Finance and presenting numbers the board can trust

  • Run and evolve the analytics stack: the semantic layer, per-brand P&L, LTV cohorts and Single Customer View

  • Turn retention economics into decisions, using cohort and CRM uplift analysis to guide where budget is invested

  • Partner directly with commercial, CRM and Finance stakeholders to answer the questions that move the vertical

  • Set the reporting standards and mentor junior analysts as the pod grows

About You

  • Senior analytics experience owning a commercial vertical end to end, with strong SQL and BigQuery and confident dashboarding in Tableau and via LLMs

  • Extensive experience building reporting pipelines and, just as important, challenging them: interrogating the taxonomy, definitions and formulas rather than accepting them as given

  • AI native in how you work: you build and ship reporting with LLM tooling as a default way of working, not an add-on

  • Grounded in retention and lifetime value economics, cohort analysis and CRM driven measurement, not only acquisition

  • Commercial, board facing judgement: you can turn analysis into a recommendation and defend a number to senior stakeholders

  • You thrive when working as part of a team

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

AI & automation

  • Support the adoption of AI and automation across IT support workflows, from ticket triage to recurring processes, so the team works efficiently and spends less time on repetitive tasks.

Your skills

  • 5+ years of experience in IT support or IT operations, including experience managing or mentoring a team.

Volta is building AI-ready data centre infrastructure across the UK, Norway, Germany, Spain and the US, and is preparing for a US public listing as a foreign private issuer following a Series A led by a16z and Altimeter. Getting our external reporting infrastructure ready - US GAAP financial statements, SEC-standard disclosures and input to the supporting close processes - is one of the finance function's defining projects over the next 12 to 16 months.

As SEC Reporting Manager you will build and run the external reporting process: preparing US GAAP consolidated financial statements and footnotes, drafting disclosures to SEC standard, and constructing the supporting evidence and tie-out discipline expected of a registrant. You will work directly with the Director of Technical Accounting and the VP Accounting and be central to the F-1 preparation and the first audited financial statements.

This is a build role, not a maintain role - you will create the reporting calendar, the disclosure checklists and the tie-out packs from scratch and see them through a first-year Big Four audit into a live registration statement.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Prepare US GAAP consolidated financial statements, including full footnote disclosures, for audit and ultimately SEC filing

  • Build and maintain the disclosure checklist and reporting calendar across annual and interim cycles

  • Own the tie-out process: every number in the statements agreed to support, referenced and reviewable

  • Manage the consolidation and FX translation (ASC 830) mechanics feeding the statements

  • Coordinate audit deliverables and respond to auditor requests through fieldwork and completion

  • Prepare statutory bridge outputs for UK filing requirements alongside the US GAAP statements

  • Implement reporting tools (disclosure management/XBRL readiness) as the function matures

  • Support quarterly reporting design ahead of public-company cadence

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

As Volta's Accounts Receivable Specialist, you'll be responsible for managing customer invoicing, collections, and cash application, ensuring Volta gets paid accurately and on time. You'll work closely with customer-facing teams and the wider Finance team to keep our receivables process running smoothly and our records accurate.

This role suits someone who's detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers, and enjoys building relationships with customers to resolve payment issues efficiently.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Generate and issue accurate customer invoices in line with contract terms and billing schedules

  • Monitor accounts receivable balances and implementing a collection protocol and following up on receivable amounts.

  • Apply incoming payments accurately and in a timely manner, resolving any discrepancies with customers or internal teams

  • Reconcile customer accounts regularly, investigating and resolving billing disputes or discrepancies

  • Partner with customer-facing teams to resolve customer billing queries and support smooth renewals

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records within the accounting or billing system

  • Support month-end close by preparing accounts receivable reports, aging schedules, and reconciliations

  • Assist with the accounts receivable elements of audits, providing documentation and supporting analysis as needed

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the invoicing and collections process

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or a similar finance role

  • Solid understanding of accounting principles as they relate to receivables, invoicing, and cash application

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial data and customer accounts

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable following up with customers on outstanding payments

  • Experience with accounting or billing software (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar)

  • Strong organizational skills, able to manage a high volume of invoices and accounts simultaneously

  • A proactive, problem-solving approach to resolving payment discrepancies and disputes

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Freetrade
description_html:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

Freetrade Engineers play a pivotal role in developing and maintaining a robust, scalable platform used by thousands daily. We tackle big technical challenges, drive innovation, and build solutions that make a real impact.

Here, your code doesn’t just run - it powers the decisions of investors across the UK.

About the role

As part of our dedicated mobile engineering team, you will work on implementing new features. In collaboration with design, product and QE teams you will craft user experiences that will delight our customers.

You will also help guide priorities around platform issues, technical debt, patterns, and architecture, ensuring we deliver a high-quality app and an excellent developer experience.

We have recently rebranded key parts of the app, creating a new design system from scratch built with Jetpack Compose, and have started transitioning to a modern, unified GraphQL API using Apollo.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of new features, alongside improving and maintaining the Freetrade Android app, ensuring high performance, quality, security and robustness.

  • Own features end to end, collaborating with backend, design, product and QA to deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Set and hold a high bar for code quality through hands-on development, code reviews and effective testing.

  • Resolve complex issues, address bottlenecks and reduce technical debt.

  • Drive improvements in engineering standards and practices.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers on design, implementation and best practices.

  • Participate in a support rota to understand and resolve customer issues, including direct communication where needed.


About you

  • Typically 6+ years of experience building production-grade mobile applications.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to lead technical decisions and deliver complex features.

  • Deep understanding of Android architecture such as MVVM or MVI.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin, Dagger, Jetpack and Compose.

  • Good understanding of GraphQL and integrating with backend services.

  • Experience with coroutines, flow or Rx.

  • Familiarity with git and collaborative development practices.

  • Understanding of CI and build tooling such as CircleCI.

  • Experience mentoring and growing more junior engineers

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration to build a strong culture, but we know "life happens." If you have caregiving or personal responsibilities that require extra flexibility, let’s talk about it.

Our interview process

We keep things simple and transparent. You’ll meet one of our Talent Partners for a technical screening call, typically followed by:

  1. Hiring Manager interview

  2. Live coding interview

  3. System design interview

  4. Final Values interview

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

title: Operational Trainer - FTC
